name: p4_stage1
question: Is there a loss of learning ability on a comparable new task? If so, is a correctly bias-corrected optimizer-state intervention distinguishable from its update-magnitude effect?
status_note: Exploratory diagnostic. Test seeds 3000-3002 were already viewed in p4_smoke_6e4cdaf (first 4 random_teacher tasks share teachers), so they are development data now; this is NOT a confirmatory experiment. All intervention timings are a pre-specified ORACLE boundary (end of the training stream).

conditions.name: random_teacher_c4
conditions.basis: existing smoke stream family and model; length from PREREGISTRATION amendment 1-4 (>= 50 tasks)

conditions.name: label_permutation_c10
conditions.basis: existing label_permutation family; 10 classes because with 4 classes only 24 permutations exist and 50 tasks would repeat them, so the probe task would not be new. Runtime assertion: probe permutation never trained.

condition_count_note: Exactly two conditions fixed before running; no length/model sweep.

seeds.note: test = first 3 seeds of the original test split, as allowed; dev = first 2 of the dev split (budget).

probe.protocol: Fixed probe task = stream task index n_train_tasks (never trained). Starting points: fresh (same initial weights, fresh optimizer), early (end of task 0, carried optimizer state), late (end of task 49, carried optimizer state). Probe data/dropout RNG replaced by derive_seed('probe', stream, seed) for every starting point: identical batches, masks and update budget.

tuning.objective: online training accuracy averaged over all steps of the 50-task stream (online accuracy as in Dohare et al. 2024); higher is better; ties -> earliest grid entry

edge_extension.rule: Same rule for every family: if the selected LR is the min or max of the grid, add ONE value (min/3 or max*3) on that side, run it on the same dev seeds, reselect. At most one extension. If the selection is still at an edge -> TUNING_UNRESOLVED (no further extension).
edge_extension.cost_bound: at most 1 extra LR x 2 dev seeds x 2 conditions = 4 trunks (~124 CPU s) per family

interventions.start: the same late checkpoint (with probe RNG) as the phenomenon 'late' probe; keep_all must reproduce that probe bitwise
interventions.information_access: All arms: current probe batch labels + ORACLE timing (intervention at the end of the training stream, i.e. at a known boundary). keepdir_* (coupled controls): additionally read the per-step, per-tensor update norms of the referenced arm's full probe run (privileged, requires running that arm first: +1 probe run of compute each). Not deployable methods.

decision.phenomenon: Per condition, base family: ESTABLISHED iff mean over 3 test seeds of (late - early) probe_auc_acc <= -0.02 AND all 3 seed differences < 0. Missing/failed cells or base tuning not RESOLVED -> INCOMPLETE. Otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED (= not observed in this setting; not evidence of absence).
decision.intervention: Per correctly-corrected X in primary: effect present iff mean (X - keep_all) probe_auc_acc >= 0.02 and all seeds > 0. DIFFERENCE_REMAINS iff effect present AND |mean (X - keepdir_Xmag)| >= 0.02 with all seeds the same sign. Else EXPLAINED_BY_UPDATE_NORM or NO_POSITIVE_EFFECT_OVER_KEEP_ALL. Any DIFFERENCE_REMAINS -> MECHANISM_PILOT_CANDIDATE (scope: this synthetic setting, oracle timing); else STATE_REPAIR_BRANCH_ON_HOLD. With n=3, no difference is NOT equivalence.
decision.not_claimed: Weights move after the intervention, so no 'without relearning features' claim is made; CKA/parameter movement are descriptive only.

cost_model.planned_cpu_s: tuning <= 60 trunks (1860) + phenomenon 6 x 37 (222) + interventions 6 x 22 (132) + secondary 12 x 37 (444) = ~2660

resource_caps.note: 3600 s is the whole-step cap; 200 s reserved for parity/unit tests and timing probes run outside this process (measured separately). Install/download cost recorded separately in runs/install/.
